results.title: Katt Williams: The Last Report
results.overview: Back for his fourth Netflix stand-up special, comedy icon Katt Williams delivers his famously bold takes on conspiracies, celebrities and the world at large in this electrifying set.

results.title: Messi: The Forgotten Tape
results.overview: A VHS featuring Lionel Messi starts a tug of war between Spain and Argentina over his loyalty.

results.title: My Best Friend
results.overview: Star has been wanting to share something with Jill for a while. Something that comes at a great price.

results.title: Monkey’s Magic Merry Go Round
results.overview: After a mysterious bout of amnesia, a beloved children’s television host struggles to piece together his fractured memories, only to find his once-cheerful puppet co-stars behaving with sinister intent. As reality unravels, the line between performance and nightmare begins to blur.

results.title: Adored
results.overview: After a devastating personal tragedy, an A-list actress retreats to a secluded island villa. But she's not alone....

results.title: The Mephistophiliac
results.overview: An alcoholic unleashes a homicidal, hellish alter ego to battle his demons, only to become a terrifying menace to everyone around him.

results.title: In This Room
results.overview: In a world that seems to be falling apart, poetry, empathy, and music remind us of the urgent need to understand one another. Through fado and the distinctive voice of its most famous singer, Carminho, a glimmer of hope emerges across the landscapes of a Japan once devastated by bombings. The film follows the Portuguese artist on tour across the country. Through concerts, backstage moments, hotel rooms, taxis, silences, and whispers, the film weaves together the world of fado and Japan’s cultural landscape.

results.title: She's Smarter Than All of Us
results.overview: Retired teacher Necla takes a mental competency test so she can sell one of her properties and pay off her son’s debts. But one question will challenge not only her memory, but also her grip on reality.

results.title: Hope Street: One of Our Own
results.original_title: Hope Street: One of Our Own
results.overview: A violent crime committed against a much-loved local and the police investigation brings bad news for DS Marlene Pettigrew. Love is also in the air and there’s a wedding to plan, but this is Port Devine, what could possibly go wrong?

results.title: The Daughter She Left Behind
results.overview: After years spent working internationally, Rachel returns home desperate to reconnect with the daughter she left behind. But when a terrifying man threatens Samantha's life, Rachel must finally become the mother she never was.

results.title: Darlene Love: I Know Where I've Been
results.original_title: Darlene Love: I Know Where I've Been
results.overview: A documentary on Darlene Love, the singer and Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductee known for “He’s a Rebel” and collaborations with Cher, Bruce Springsteen, Dionne Warwick, Sam Cooke and other greats.

results.title: The Man with the Plan
results.overview: A student goes on a fantastical journey inspired by the words of social economist William Beveridge in his eponymous 1942 report. The film is currently screening in London: https://www.sandsfilms.co.uk/the-man-with-the-plan.html and will screen across the country from September 2026

results.title: Refuge
results.overview: Four estranged friends reunite on a fishing trip, but a missing child and a desperate father's accusation turn reunion into a deadly reckoning

results.title: Beliath
results.overview: What begins as a routine crime report soon spirals into a descent through eerie folklore, buried cults, and unsettling discoveries that blur the line between journalism and obsession.

results.title: Cocon
results.overview: Koki is a young Japanese devoted to his work. One day, in a crowded subway, everything changes. He decides to quit his job, retreat to his home, and shut himself away, like a hikikomori, never to go out again.

results.title: Water Poem
results.overview: Water Poem is an experimental documentary short film in which a Vietnamese trans man recites a poem as images drift and shift beneath words, in an exploration of water against boundaries of time. A meditation on transness, ancestral memory, and grief on the body that carries the way a river carries sediment.

results.title: Pigeons
results.overview: In a world that keeps changing, PIGEONS follows a carrier pigeon who loses his job the day a telephone is installed in his owner’s home. Searching for food, shelter, and purpose, the film explores freedom, progress, and what gets lost along the way.

results.title: Muscle Beach
results.overview: After soaring high and flaming out in Hollywood, Abe, a celebrated bodybuilder, returns home across the 405 to Venice Beach, where it all started. But Abe's beloved boardwalk feels different. There’s a nasty bite to the sea breeze, a slew of unexplained overdoses putting the gym rats on edge, strange supernatural sightings on the pier hinting at something primordial lurking beneath the surface of sun-dappled Venice. And Jay—his old lifting partner, his former roommate, the one person he truly abandoned in his pursuit of fame—has disappeared, leaving Alice, his ex, alone to take care of their infant son.

results.title: Apuntes para una ficción consentida
results.overview: Swiss actress Lea Grand lives in Madrid, turning away from roles that make her foreignness her defining trait while developing a cabaret built from Saint Teresa of Avila’s words. When Basel Stadt theater invites her back to her home city, performance opens an unsettled question of belonging.
